---
title: "Reaction Time Explorer"
---

Reaction time measures how fast children shift their gaze once the target
word starts. It is the moment a look that began on the distractor first lands
on the target, so only trials that started on the distractor count. The onset-contingent
curves show how many trials have moved off the starting image over time, for
trials starting on either image.

```{ojs rt-inputs}
viewof all_datasets = allToggle()
viewof sel_datasets = Inputs.checkbox(datasetNames, {
  label: "Datasets", value: ["pomper_saffran_2016"],
  format: (d) => datasetLabel(d), disabled: all_datasets,
})
html`<p class="viz-note">${active_datasets.length} of ${datasetNames.length} selected</p>`
viewof age_range = interval([0, 84], {
  step: 1, value: [0, 84], label: "Ages (months)",
})
viewof age_nbins = Inputs.range([1, 6], {
  step: 1, value: 2, label: "Age groups",
})
viewof sel_words = Inputs.checkbox(allWords, { label: "Words", value: [] })
html`<p class="viz-note">${sel_words.length
  ? `${sel_words.length} selected` : "None checked: all words combined"}</p>`
viewof rt_range = interval([0, 4000], {
  step: 25, value: [0, 4000], label: "RT range (ms)",
})
viewof onset_window = interval([0, 4000], {
  step: 25, value: [0, 4000], label: "Onset plot window (ms)",
})
viewof include_excluded = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Include excluded trials", value: true })
```

:::

::: {.viz-main}

```{ojs rt-data}
//| output: false
active_datasets = all_datasets ? datasetNames : sel_datasets
slices = Promise.all(active_datasets.map(loadSlice))
allWords = wordsOf(slices)

rows = {
  const useAll = sel_words.length === 0;
  return buildRows(slices, {
    ageLo: age_range[0], ageHi: age_range[1],
    words: useAll ? null : sel_words,
    includeExcluded: include_excluded,
    collapseWords: useAll,
  });
}

binner = makeAgeBinner(Array.from(new Set(rows.map((r) => r.age))), age_nbins)
groupedRows = rows.map((r) => ({ ...r, age_bin: binner.labels[binner.bin(r.age)] }))

rtTrials = {
  const out = [];
  for (const r of groupedRows) {
    const res = trialRT(r.t0, r.runs);
    if (res && res.rt != null && res.rt >= rt_range[0] && res.rt <= rt_range[1]) {
      out.push({ ...res, age_bin: r.age_bin, word: r.word, age: r.age,
                 dataset: r.dataset, aid: r.aid, tid: r.tid });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

rtMeans = {
  const dt = rtTrials.filter((d) => d.shift_type === "D-T");
  const out = [];
  for (const [bin, byWord] of d3.group(dt, (d) => d.age_bin, (d) => d.word)) {
    for (const [word, g] of byWord) {
      const mean = d3.mean(g, (d) => d.rt);
      const sem = (d3.deviation(g, (d) => d.rt) || 0) / Math.sqrt(g.length);
      out.push({ age_bin: bin, word, n_trials: g.length, mean_rt: mean,
                 ci_lower: mean - 1.96 * sem, ci_upper: mean + 1.96 * sem });
    }
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.age_bin, b.age_bin));
}

onsetData = {
  const [tLo, tHi] = onset_window;
  const shiftByTrial = new Map();
  for (const r of groupedRows) {
    const res = trialRT(r.t0, r.runs);
    if (res && (res.shift_type === "D-T" || res.shift_type === "T-D")) {
      shiftByTrial.set(`${r.aid}|${r.tid}`, res.shift_type);
    }
  }
  const acc = new Map();
  for (const r of groupedRows) {
    const st = shiftByTrial.get(`${r.aid}|${r.tid}`);
    if (!st) continue;
    let t = r.t0;
    for (const [aoi, len] of r.runs) {
      for (let k = 0; k < len; k++, t += STEP_MS) {
        if (t < tLo || t >= tHi) continue;
        const key = `${t}|${st}|${r.age_bin}`;
        let e = acc.get(key);
        if (!e) acc.set(key, e = { t, shift_type: st, age_bin: r.age_bin, n: 0, s: 0 });
        e.n += 1;
        if (st === "T-D" ? aoi === 1 : aoi === 0) e.s += 1;
      }
    }
  }
  return Array.from(acc.values(), (e) => ({
    t: e.t, shift_type: e.shift_type, age_bin: e.age_bin, n: e.n,
    prop_shifted: e.s / e.n,
  })).sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### RT by age

```{ojs rt-means-plot}
{
  markReady();
  const facets = new Set(rtMeans.map((d) => d.word));
  const ageGroups = orderedBins(binner.labels, rtMeans);
  return plot({
    height: Math.max(380, 220 * Math.ceil(facets.size / 3)),
    x: { label: "Age group (months)", domain: ageGroups,
      ...barPadding(ageGroups.length, facets.size) },
    y: { label: "Reaction time (ms)" },
    color: { domain: orderedBins(binner.labels, rtMeans) },
    fx: facets.size > 1 ? { label: null } : undefined,
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(rtMeans, {
        x: "age_bin", y: "mean_rt", fill: "age_bin",
        tip: true, title: (d) => `${d.age_bin} months\n${Math.round(d.mean_rt)} ms ` +
          `[${Math.round(d.ci_lower)}, ${Math.round(d.ci_upper)}]\n${d.n_trials} trials`,
        ...(facets.size > 1 ? { fx: "word" } : {}),
      }),
      Plot.ruleX(rtMeans, {
        x: "age_bin", y1: "ci_lower", y2: "ci_upper",
        ...(facets.size > 1 ? { fx: "word" } : {}),
      }),
    ],
  });
}
```

Mean reaction time on distractor-initial trials; whiskers are 95%
confidence intervals.

### Distribution

```{ojs rt-hist-plot}
plot({
  height: 400,
  x: { label: "RT (ms)" },
  y: { label: "Trials" },
  color: { legend: true, label: "Age group (months)",
    domain: orderedBins(binner.labels, rtTrials) },
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(rtTrials.filter((d) => d.shift_type === "D-T"),
      Plot.binX({ y: "count" }, {
        x: "rt", fill: "age_bin", opacity: 0.6, interval: 100,
        mixBlendMode: "multiply", tip: true,
      })),
  ],
})
```

### Onset-contingent

```{ojs rt-onset-plot}
{
  const facets = new Set(onsetData.map((d) => d.age_bin));
  return plot({
    height: Math.max(400, 220 * Math.ceil(facets.size / 2)),
    grid: true, marginRight: 60,
    x: { label: "Time (ms)" },
    y: { label: "Prop. shifted from onset image", domain: [0, 1] },
    fy: facets.size > 1
      ? { label: null, domain: orderedBins(binner.labels, onsetData) }
      : undefined,
    marks: [
      Plot.lineY(onsetData.filter((d) => d.shift_type === "D-T"), {
        x: "t", y: "prop_shifted", stroke: "#2563eb",
        tip: true, title: (d) => `Distractor-initial\n${d.prop_shifted.toFixed(2)} at ${d.t} ms (n=${d.n})`,
        ...(facets.size > 1 ? { fy: "age_bin" } : {}),
      }),
      Plot.lineY(onsetData.filter((d) => d.shift_type === "T-D"), {
        x: "t", y: "prop_shifted", stroke: "#2563eb", strokeDasharray: "5 4",
        tip: true, title: (d) => `Target-initial\n${d.prop_shifted.toFixed(2)} at ${d.t} ms (n=${d.n})`,
        ...(facets.size > 1 ? { fy: "age_bin" } : {}),
      }),
      Plot.ruleY([0.5], { strokeDasharray: "4 4" }),
    ],
  });
}
```

Solid: distractor-initial (D-T). Dashed: target-initial (T-D).

### Data

```{ojs rt-table}
Inputs.table(rtMeans, {
  format: { mean_rt: (d) => d.toFixed(0), ci_lower: (d) => d.toFixed(0),
            ci_upper: (d) => d.toFixed(0) },
  header: { age_bin: "Age group (months)", word: "Word", n_trials: "Trials",
            mean_rt: "Mean RT (ms)", ci_lower: "95% CI lower", ci_upper: "95% CI upper" },
})
```
